name: Elevate Image Zoom (elevatezoom)
description: Image field formatter that adds a jQuery ElevateZoom Plus magnify/zoom effect (and lightbox gallery) to image fields.
project_description:
base on module Elevate Image Zoom .

 

 Enhance your product images with the ElevateZoom Plus Module, now powered by the advanced jQuery ElevateZoom Plus Plugin . ElevateZoom Plus brings a host of new effects and features for a more immersive image viewing experience.

it uses CDN so you don't need to download to libraries.

 Features

 
 Fully Customisable 
 Coloured Tints 
 Fancybox-Plus and Colorbox Gallery Support 
 Variable zoom on mouse scroll 
 External Controls 
 Window Zoom, Lens Zoom and Inner Zoom 
 
 View demo 

 
 Basic Zoom 
 Tints 
 Gallery & Lightbox 
 Window Position 
 Lens Zoom 
 Inner Zoom 
 Fade In - Fade Out 
 External Controls 
 Easing 
 Scroll Zoom 
 Zoom Level 
 Zoom Window Size 
 Zoom with Image Constrain 
 Responsive
